caption: The drawing depicts a single, vertically oriented object resembling a decorative architectural element, such as a classical capital. The object is centrally positioned and rendered in varying shades of brown, with darker brown areas used to indicate shadow and depth, giving the form a three-dimensional appearance. The design features two prominent, symmetrical spiral volutes at the upper section, flanking a central vertical stem that extends the length of the object. Below the volutes, pairs of additional smaller spirals curve inward towards the central axis. The lower portion of the object displays stylized leaf and stem motifs, with several pointed leaves curving upwards and outwards alongside the central stem. The base and top of the object are delineated with horizontal bands. The background is a plain, off-white or light beige color with no additional elements or patterns.
title: Leaf and Scroll
